questions.question:
A shopkeeper announces the following three discount schemes. Which scheme is the most beneficial for the customer?

A. Buy 5 items and get 2 identical items free

B. Two successive discounts of 13% and 38%

C. Two equal successive discounts of 21%
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Scheme A: Buy 5 get 22 free ⇒ pay for 5, get 27 ⇒ effective discount = (22/27) × 100 ≈ 81.48%

Scheme B: 13% and 38% successive ⇒ net = 1 − (0.87 × 0.62) = 46.06%

Scheme C: 21% twice ⇒ net = 1 − (0.79 × 0.79) = 37.59%

Compare: 81.48% > 46.06% > 37.59%

**∴ Answer = Scheme A is most beneficial**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Three discount schemes A, B, C

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = 1 − (product of remaining fractions)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Scheme A: Buy 5 get 22 free

⇒ Total items = 5 + 22 = 27

⇒ Effective discount = (22 ÷ 27) × 100 ≈ 81.48%

⇒ Scheme B: 13% and 38%

⇒ Net discount = 1 − (0.87 × 0.62) = 1 − 0.5394 = 46.06%

⇒ Scheme C: 21% and 21%

⇒ Net discount = 1 − (0.79 × 0.79) = 1 − 0.6241 = 37.59%

⇒ Comparing all: Scheme A gives highest discount

**∴ The correct answer is Scheme A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net discount = 1 − (1 − d1)(1 − d2)

Free Item Concept

Effective discount = Free items ÷ Total items × 100

Comparison Trick

Convert all schemes into percentage discount

Key Insight

Higher effective discount ⇒ better scheme

questions.question: If the mode of the data 12, 9, 10, 12, 13, (2K - 2), 13, 19, 15, and 17 is 12, find the value of K.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mode = 12 ⇒ it must appear maximum times

Already 12 appears 2 times

So (2K − 2) must also be 12 to increase frequency

2K − 2 = 12 ⇒ 2K = 14 ⇒ K = 7

**∴ Answer = 7**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Data: 12, 9, 10, 12, 13, (2K − 2), 13, 19, 15, 17

Mode = 12

**Formula used:**

Mode = Most frequently occurring value

**Calculation:**

⇒ Frequency of 12 = 2

⇒ Frequency of 13 = 2

⇒ To make 12 the mode, its frequency must increase

⇒ So (2K − 2) = 12

⇒ 2K − 2 = 12

⇒ 2K = 14

⇒ K = 7

**∴ The correct answer is 7.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mode Definition

Mode is the value that occurs most frequently in a dataset

Frequency Concept

Count occurrences of each value to identify mode

Tie Case

If two values have same frequency, no unique mode exists

Key Insight

Adjust unknown term to maximize frequency of given mode

questions.question: If tan A = (6)/(7) , find the value of (7 sin A + 2 cos A)/(7 sin A - 2 cos A) .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Take cos A common from numerator and denominator

(7 sin A + 2 cos A) / (7 sin A − 2 cos A) = (cos A(7 tan A + 2)) / (cos A(7 tan A − 2))

Cancel cos A ⇒ (7 tan A + 2) / (7 tan A − 2)

Substitute tan A = 6/7 ⇒ (6 + 2) / (6 − 2)

= 8/4 = 2

**∴ Answer = 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

tan A = 6/7

**Formula used:**

sin A = tan A × cos A

**Calculation:**

⇒ Expression = (7 sin A + 2 cos A) / (7 sin A − 2 cos A)

⇒ Replace sin A = tan A × cos A

⇒ = (7 tan A cos A + 2 cos A) / (7 tan A cos A − 2 cos A)

⇒ = cos A(7 tan A + 2) / cos A(7 tan A − 2)

⇒ Cancel cos A

⇒ = (7 tan A + 2) / (7 tan A − 2)

⇒ Substitute tan A = 6/7

⇒ = (6 + 2) / (6 − 2)

⇒ = 8/4 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Identity Used

sin A = tan A × cos A

Simplification Trick

Take common factor to reduce expression quickly

Ratio Concept

Using tan avoids finding sin and cos separately

Exam Tip

Always convert expression in terms of given ratio

questions.question:
The volume of a solid cylinder is 34,650 cm³ . If the height is 25 cm, then the circumference of the base is:

(Use pi = (22)/(7) )
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cylinder = Base Area × Height

⇒ Base Area = 34650 ÷ 25 = 1386 cm²

⇒ πr² = 1386 ⇒ (22/7) × r² = 1386 ⇒ r² = 441 ⇒ r = 21 cm

Circumference of base = 2πr = 2 × (22/7) × 21 = 132 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 132 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Volume of the solid cylinder (V) = 34,650 cm³

Height of the cylinder (h) = 25 cm

Value of π = 22/7

 Volume = 34,650 cm³ 
 
 
• r 
• 
• 
• h = 25 cm 

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cylinder = πr²h

Circumference of the circular base = 2πr

**Calculations:**

⇒ πr²h = 34650

⇒ (22/7) × r² × 25 = 34650

⇒ r² = (34650 × 7) ÷ (22 × 25)

⇒ r² = (34650 × 7) ÷ 550

⇒ r² = 63 × 7

⇒ r² = 441

⇒ r = √441 = 21 cm

Now, substitute the value of radius (r) to find the circumference of the base:

⇒ Circumference = 2πr

⇒ Circumference = 2 × (22/7) × 21

⇒ Circumference = 2 × 22 × 3

⇒ Circumference = 132 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 132 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cylinder

It represents the area of the curved surface excluding the flat top and bottom bases. Formula: CSA = 2πrh

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a Cylinder

It includes the curved surface area along with the areas of the two circular bases. Formula: TSA = 2πr(r + h)

Volume of a Cone

A cone with the same base radius and height as a cylinder will have exactly one-third of the cylinder's volume. Formula: Volume = (1/3)πr²h

questions.question: Two cars start from the same point and travel in the same direction. If one car travels at a speed of 55 km/h and the other at 72 km/h, how far apart will they be after 3 hours?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Same direction ⇒ relative speed = difference of speeds

Relative speed = 72 − 55 = 17 km/hr

Distance after 3 hours = 17 × 3 = 51 km

**∴ Answer = 51 km**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of car 1 = 55 km/hr

Speed of car 2 = 72 km/hr

Time = 3 hours

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Distance covered by first car = 55 × 3 = 165 km

⇒ Distance covered by second car = 72 × 3 = 216 km

⇒ Distance between them = 216 − 165 = 51 km

**∴ The correct answer is 51 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

Same direction ⇒ subtract speeds

Distance Formula

Distance = Speed × Time

Key Concept

Distance between moving objects depends on relative speed

Exam Tip

Use relative speed for faster calculation

questions.question: A person spent ₹14,000 on groceries, ₹8,000 on house rent, and ₹10,000 on children's school fees, and kept the remaining 20% ​​of their total income in cash. Find their income.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total expenses = 14000 + 8000 + 10000 = 32000

He keeps 20% ⇒ spends 80%

80% of income = 32000

Income = 32000 ÷ 0.8 = 40000

**∴ Answer = 40000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expenses: 14000, 8000, 10000

Remaining saving = 20% of total income

**Formula used:**

Income = Expenditure + Saving

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total expenditure = 14000 + 8000 + 10000 = 32000

⇒ Let total income = x

⇒ Saving = 20% of x = 0.2x

⇒ Expenditure = 80% of x = 0.8x

⇒ 0.8x = 32000

⇒ x = 32000 ÷ 0.8 = 40000

**∴ The correct answer is 40000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income Relation

Income = Expenditure + Saving

Percentage Concept

If saving is 20%, expenditure is 80%

Reverse Calculation

Original value = Known part ÷ percentage fraction

Shortcut Insight

Convert percentage to decimal for quick solving

questions.question: A force of 1,206 soldiers has provisions for 24 days. If the number of soldiers in the force is increased to 1,809, for how many days will the provisions last?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total provision is constant, so the number of days is inversely proportional to the number of men.

Ratio of Men = 1206 : 1809 = 2 : 3

⇒ Ratio of Days = 3 : 2

Here, 3 units corresponds to 24 days, so 1 unit = 8 days.

⇒ New duration (2 units) = 2 × 8 = 16 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 16 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial number of men (M₁) = 1206

Initial duration in days (D₁) = 24

New number of men (M₂) = 1809

**Formula Used:**

M₁ × D₁ = M₂ × D₂ (Total provision remains constant)

questions.question: The sum of two numbers is 25. One of them is 9 greater than the other. Find the numbers.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference = 9, Sum = 25

Numbers = (25 ± 9)/2

Larger = (25 + 9)/2 = 17

Smaller = (25 − 9)/2 = 8

**∴ Answer = 17 and 8**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of two numbers = 25

One number is 9 more than the other

**Formula used:**

Let smaller = x, larger = x + 9

**Calculation:**

⇒ x + (x + 9) = 25

⇒ 2x + 9 = 25

⇒ 2x = 16

⇒ x = 8

⇒ Larger number = 8 + 9 = 17

**∴ The correct answer is 17 and 8.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum-Difference Formula

Numbers = (Sum ± Difference)/2

Linear Equation

Form equation using given conditions

Substitution Method

Replace one variable in terms of another

Verification

Check sum and difference after solving

questions.question: If 50% of 80% of half of a number is 442, find the number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplying fraction = 1/2 × 80% × 50%

⇒ 1/2 × 4/5 × 1/2 = 1/5

Let the required number be N, then 1/5 of N = 442

⇒ N = 442 × 5 = 2210

**∴ The correct answer is 2210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

50% of 80% of 1/2 of a number = 442

 Number 
• 
 × 1/2 0.5x 
• 
 × 80% 0.4x 
• 
 × 50% 442 
 Total Multiplier = 1/2 × 80% × 50% = 1/5 Sequential Multiplication Flow 

**Calculations:**

Let the required number be x.

⇒ 50% of 80% of 1/2 of x = 442

⇒ (50 ÷ 100) × (80 ÷ 100) × (1/2) × x = 442

⇒ (1/2) × (4/5) × (1/2) × x = 442

⇒ (4 ÷ 20) × x = 442

⇒ (1/5) × x = 442

⇒ x = 442 × 5

⇒ x = 2210

**∴ The correct answer is 2210.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

Using fractions directly helps in faster calculations: 50% = 1/2, 80% = 4/5, 25% = 1/4, 20% = 1/5, etc.

Successive Percentage Calculation

For a sequence of percentages on a base value, simply multiply the respective fractional equivalents together: Final Value = Base × Frac₁ × Frac₂.

BODMAS Rule

In mathematical expressions, 'of' denotes multiplication and must be performed before division and normal multiplication operations.

questions.question: A metallic sphere of radius 36 cm is dropped into a cylindrical vessel, which is partly filled with water. The diameter of the vessel is 4.8 metres. If the sphere is completely submerged, find by how much the surface of the water will rise.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume displaced = volume of sphere

Rise in water = Volume ÷ Base area of cylinder

r(sphere) = 36 cm ⇒ Volume = (4/3)π × 36³

Radius of cylinder = 4.8/2 = 2.4 m = 240 cm

Height rise = [(4/3)π × 36³] ÷ [π × 240²] = (4 × 36³) ÷ (3 × 240²)

= (4 × 46656) ÷ (3 × 57600) = 186624 ÷ 172800 ≈ 1.08 cm

**∴ Answer ≈ 1.08 cm**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of sphere = 36 cm

Diameter of cylinder = 4.8 m = 480 cm ⇒ radius = 240 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of sphere = (4/3)πr³

Volume of cylinder = πR²h

 
• 
• 

Sphere submerged in cylindrical vessel

**Calculation:**

⇒ Volume of sphere = (4/3)π × 36³ = (4/3)π × 46656

⇒ Let rise in water = h

⇒ Volume displaced = π × 240² × h

⇒ (4/3)π × 46656 = π × 240² × h

⇒ Cancel π

⇒ h = [(4/3) × 46656] ÷ (240²)

⇒ h = 186624 ÷ 172800 ≈ 1.08 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 1.08 cm (approx).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Displacement Principle

Volume of water displaced = volume of immersed object

Cylinder Volume

Volume = Base area × height = πR²h

Unit Conversion

Convert all units into same system before solving

Key Insight

Equate displaced volume with cylinder volume rise

questions.question: A shopkeeper bought 20 kg of apples for ₹3,600 and sold them at the rate of ₹220/kg. How much profit (in ₹) did he make?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

CP per kg = 3600 ÷ 20 = 180

SP per kg = 220

Profit per kg = 220 − 180 = 40

Total profit = 40 × 20 = 800

**∴ Answer = ₹800**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total cost price = 3600 for 20 kg

Selling price per kg = 220

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP − CP

**Calculation:**

⇒ CP per kg = 3600 ÷ 20 = 180

⇒ Total selling price = 220 × 20 = 4400

⇒ Profit = 4400 − 3600 = 800

**∴ The correct answer is ₹800.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Profit Formula

Profit = Selling Price − Cost Price

Unitary Method

Find per unit cost, then multiply

Total SP

Total SP = rate × quantity

Key Insight

Always compare total SP and total CP

questions.question: Three numbers are in the ratio 7 : 20 : 8, and their sum is 4830. Find the middle number.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio = 7 : 20 : 8 ⇒ Total parts = 35

1 part = 4830 ÷ 35 = 138

Middle number = 20 × 138

= 2760

**∴ Answer = 2760**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers are in ratio 7 : 20 : 8

Total sum = 4830

**Formula used:**

Value = (Ratio part ÷ Total ratio) × Sum

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let numbers be 7x, 20x, 8x

⇒ Total = 7x + 20x + 8x = 35x

⇒ 35x = 4830

⇒ x = 4830 ÷ 35 = 138

⇒ Middle number = 20x = 20 × 138 = 2760

**∴ The correct answer is 2760.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Concept

Values are proportional to their ratio parts

Total Parts

Sum of ratio parts helps find unit value

Unitary Method

Find value of 1 part, then multiply

Key Insight

Middle term corresponds to middle ratio part

questions.question: Find the value of ((0.12)² + (0.123)² + (0.1234)²)/((0.012)² + (0.0123)² + (0.01234)²)
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Each term in numerator is 10 times the corresponding denominator term

So squares become 100 times

Numerator = 100 × Denominator

**∴ Answer = 100**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

((0.12)² + (0.123)² + (0.1234)²) ÷ ((0.012)² + (0.0123)² + (0.01234)²)

**Formula used:**

(a × 10)² = 100a²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 0.12 = 10 × 0.012

⇒ 0.123 = 10 × 0.0123

⇒ 0.1234 = 10 × 0.01234

⇒ Square both sides

⇒ (0.12)² = 100 × (0.012)²

⇒ (0.123)² = 100 × (0.0123)²

⇒ (0.1234)² = 100 × (0.01234)²

⇒ Numerator = 100 × [(0.012)² + (0.0123)² + (0.01234)²]

⇒ Expression = 100

**∴ The correct answer is 100.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Scaling Property

If a number is multiplied by 10, its square becomes 100 times.

Decimal Shift

Moving decimal one place left divides by 10.

Common Factor Method

Take common factor from numerator and denominator to simplify.

questions.question: A certain sum of money triples itself in 8 years at simple interest. In how many years will it become four times itself?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In SI, interest ∝ time

Triple ⇒ interest = 2P in 8 years

Four times ⇒ interest = 3P

Time ∝ interest ⇒ time = 8 × (3/2)

**∴ Answer = 12 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A sum becomes 3 times in 8 years at simple interest

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ When amount becomes 3P ⇒ SI = 2P

⇒ 2P = (P × R × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ 2 = (R × 8) ÷ 100

⇒ R = 200 ÷ 8 = 25

⇒ For 4P ⇒ SI = 3P

⇒ 3P = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 3 = (25 × T) ÷ 100

⇒ T = 12

**∴ The correct answer is 12 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Growth

In SI, interest increases linearly with time.

Multiplication Rule

If amount becomes n times, SI = (n − 1)P.

Direct Proportion

Time ∝ Interest when rate is constant.

questions.question: If 2a + b + c = 0 and 8a³ + b³ + c³ = kabc , then find the value of k² .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given 2a + b + c = 0 ⇒ (2a), b, c satisfy x + y + z = 0

Use identity: x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz when sum = 0

⇒ 8a³ + b³ + c³ = 3 × (2a × b × c)

⇒ = 6abc ⇒ k = 6

**∴ k² = 36**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

2a + b + c = 0 and 8a³ + b³ + c³ = kabc

**Formula used:**

If x + y + z = 0, then x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let x = 2a, y = b, z = c

⇒ Then x + y + z = 0

⇒ Apply identity: x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

⇒ 8a³ + b³ + c³ = 3 × (2a × b × c)

⇒ = 6abc

⇒ k = 6

⇒ k² = 36

**∴ The correct answer is 36.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Cubic Identity

If x + y + z = 0, then x³ + y³ + z³ = 3xyz

Substitution Trick

Replace terms to match known identities.

Power Relation

(2a)³ = 8a³

questions.question: 7 men or 6 women can do a job in 15 days. 7 men work for 8 days and leave. The number of women required to complete the remaining work in 6 days is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

7 men or 6 women complete the work in 15 days, so 7 men = 6 women.

Therefore, 7 men working for 8 days is exactly equivalent to 6 women working for 8 days.

Total work = 6 women × 15 days = 90 woman-days.

Work done in 8 days = 6 women × 8 days = 48 woman-days.

Remaining work = 90 − 48 = 42 woman-days.

Number of women needed to complete 42 woman-days in 6 days = 42 ÷ 6 = 7.

**∴ The correct answer is 7 women.**

questions.question: Simplify (24 - 6 times 3) + 18 div 3 times 2 .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly (Brackets → Division → Multiplication → Addition):

⇒ (24 − 18) + 18 ÷ 3 × 2

⇒ 6 + 6 × 2

⇒ 6 + 12 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (24 − 6 × 3) + 18 ÷ 3 × 2

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule: B (Brackets) → O (Of) → D (Division) → M (Multiplication) → A (Addition) → S (Subtraction)

**Calculations:**

(24 − 6 × 3) + 18 ÷ 3 × 2

⇒ (24 − 18) + 18 ÷ 3 × 2

⇒ 6 + 6 × 2

⇒ 6 + 12 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the correct order of operations in mathematical expressions: Brackets, Order (Powers/Roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Types of Brackets

Always solve brackets in this strict order: Line Bracket (Vinculum), Round Brackets (), Curly Brackets {}, and finally Square Brackets [].

Multiplication and Division

Division and Multiplication have the same precedence level. However, following the BODMAS acronym, we systematically perform division before multiplication to avoid calculation errors.

questions.question: During the New Year sale, a company is offering a ‘Buy 9 sweaters, get 3 free’ deal to customers. What is the percentage discount offered in this deal?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Buy 9, get 3 free ⇒ total = 12 items

You pay for 9 but get 12

Discount = free items ÷ total items = 3 ÷ 12

⇒ Discount % = (3/12) × 100

**∴ Answer = 25%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Offer: Buy 9 sweaters, get 3 free

**Formula used:**

Discount % = (Free items ÷ Total items received) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total sweaters received = 9 + 3 = 12

⇒ Cost paid is for 9 sweaters

⇒ Free sweaters = 3

⇒ Discount = 3 ÷ 12

⇒ Discount % = (3/12) × 100

⇒ = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Free Item Concept

Discount = (Free items ÷ Total items received) × 100

Equivalent Discount

Buy x get y free ⇒ Discount = y ÷ (x + y)

Shortcut Formula

Discount % = [Free ÷ Total] × 100

questions.question: The price of a washing machine is 20% less than the price of a TV. If the price of the washing machine increases by 45% and the price of the TV decreases by 38%, what will be the percentage change in the total cost of 5 washing machines and 4 TVs?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume TV = 100 ⇒ Washing Machine = 80

Initial total = 5 × 80 + 4 × 100 = 400 + 400 = 800

New WM = 80 × 1.45 = 116, New TV = 100 × 0.62 = 62

New total = 5 × 116 + 4 × 62 = 580 + 248 = 828

Change = 28 ⇒ % change = (28/800) × 100 = 3.5%

**∴ Answer = 3.5% increase**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Washing machine is 20% less than TV

WM increases by 45%, TV decreases by 38%

Quantities: 5 WM and 4 TV

**Formula used:**

Percentage change = (New − Old) ÷ Old × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let TV = 100 ⇒ WM = 80

⇒ Initial total = 5 × 80 + 4 × 100 = 800

⇒ New WM = 80 × 145/100 = 116

⇒ New TV = 100 × 62/100 = 62

⇒ New total = 5 × 116 + 4 × 62 = 828

⇒ Change = 828 − 800 = 28

⇒ % change = (28 ÷ 800) × 100 = 3.5%

**∴ The correct answer is 3.5% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumption Method

Take convenient value like 100 to simplify percentage problems.

Successive Change

Increase ⇒ multiply by (1 + x/100), decrease ⇒ multiply by (1 − x/100).

Weighted Total

When quantities differ, calculate total instead of averaging percentages.

questions.question: A cricketer's average score over 5 innings is 55. If he scores 166 runs in the sixth inning, by how many runs (rounded to the nearest whole number) will his average score increase?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Old total = 5 × 55 = 275

New total = 275 + 166 = 441

New average = 441 ÷ 6 = 73.5

Increase = 73.5 − 55 = 18.5 ≈ 19

**∴ Answer = 19 runs**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average of 5 innings = 55

Runs in 6th inning = 166

**Formula used:**

Average = Total runs ÷ Number of innings

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total runs in 5 innings = 5 × 55 = 275

⇒ Total runs in 6 innings = 275 + 166 = 441

⇒ New average = 441 ÷ 6 = 73.5

⇒ Increase in average = 73.5 − 55 = 18.5

⇒ Rounded value = 19

**∴ The correct answer is 19 runs.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Formula

Average = Total ÷ Number of observations

New Average

Add new value to total and divide by updated count.

Rounding Rule

0.5 or above rounds up to next integer.

questions.question: Sakshi goes to a shopping mall at a speed of 36 km/hr and returns at a speed of 24 km/hr. Find her average speed (in km/hr) for the entire journey.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For equal distance, average speed = (2ab)/(a + b)

⇒ = (2 × 36 × 24) ÷ (36 + 24)

⇒ = 1728 ÷ 60

⇒ = 28.8

**∴ Answer = 28.8 km/hr**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed while going = 36 km/hr

Speed while returning = 24 km/hr

**Formula used:**

Average speed = Total distance ÷ Total time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let distance = 72 km

⇒ Time taken going = 72 ÷ 36 = 2 hours

⇒ Time taken returning = 72 ÷ 24 = 3 hours

⇒ Total distance = 72 + 72 = 144 km

⇒ Total time = 2 + 3 = 5 hours

⇒ Average speed = 144 ÷ 5 = 28.8 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 28.8 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed Formula

For equal distances: Average speed = (2ab)/(a + b)

Key Concept

Average of speeds is not simple mean unless time is equal.

Shortcut Tip

Use harmonic mean for equal distance problems.

questions.question: In triangle ABC , BD perp AC at point D and angle DBC = 72^circ . There is a point E on BC such that angle CAE = 71^circ . What is the measure of angle AEB ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In right-angled ΔBDC, ∠C = 90° − ∠DBC = 90° − 72° = 18°.

In ΔAEC, side CE is extended to point B.

By the Exterior Angle Theorem, the exterior ∠AEB = ∠CAE + ∠C

⇒ ∠AEB = 71° + 18° = 89°.

**∴ The correct answer is 89°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ BD ⊥ AC at D, so ∠BDC = 90°.

⇒ ∠DBC = 72°.

⇒ E is a point on BC such that ∠CAE = 71°.

 
 
• 
• 
 
 ? 
 18° 
 71° 
 72° A B C D E 

**Calculation:**

⇒ In right-angled ΔBDC, the sum of angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠C = 180° − (∠BDC + ∠DBC)

⇒ ∠C = 180° − (90° + 72°) = 18°

⇒ In ΔAEC, the sum of interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − (∠CAE + ∠C)

⇒ ∠AEC = 180° − (71° + 18°) = 180° − 89° = 91°

⇒ Since B, E, and C lie on a straight line, ∠AEB and ∠AEC form a linear pair.

⇒ ∠AEB + ∠AEC = 180°

⇒ ∠AEB = 180° − 91° = 89°

**∴ The correct answer is 89°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Exterior Angle Theorem

The measure of an exterior angle of a triangle is exactly equal to the sum of the measures of its two opposite (remote) interior angles. Using this theorem skips the need to find the third interior angle.

Angle Sum Property of a Triangle

The sum of all three interior angles of any planar triangle is always equal to 180°. It implies that if any two angles are known, the third can be found directly.

Linear Pair Axiom

When two angles form a straight continuous line, they are considered supplementary angles. This means their total sum will consistently measure exactly 180°.

questions.question: Eight years ago, a mother's age was five times that of her daughter. Two years from now, the mother's age will be three times that of her daughter. Find the ratio of the mother's current age to her daughter's current age.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From 8 years ago: M − 8 = 5(D − 8)

From 2 years later: M + 2 = 3(D + 2)

Solve quickly by substitution

D = 18 and M = 58

**∴ Answer = 29 : 9**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Let present age of mother = M

Let present age of daughter = D

8 years ago: M − 8 = 5 × (D − 8)

After 2 years: M + 2 = 3 × (D + 2)

**Formula used:**

Linear equations: solve simultaneous equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ M − 8 = 5D − 40

⇒ M = 5D − 32

⇒ M + 2 = 3D + 6

⇒ M = 3D + 4

⇒ 5D − 32 = 3D + 4

⇒ 2D = 36

⇒ D = 18

⇒ M = 3 × 18 + 4

⇒ M = 54 + 4

⇒ M = 58

⇒ Ratio = M : D = 58 : 18

⇒ Ratio = 29 : 9

**∴ The correct answer is 29 : 9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equation Concept

Translate time-based statements into algebraic equations.

Simultaneous Equations

Solve two equations to find unknown values.

Ratio Simplification

Divide by common factor to simplify ratio.

questions.question: ₹3,787 is divided among A, B, C and D such that the shares of A and B, B and C, and C and D are in the ratio 4 : 5, 4 : 5 and 6 : 7 respectively. Find A's share (in ₹).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A : B = 4 : 5 and B : C = 4 : 5 ⇒ A : B : C = 16 : 20 : 25

C : D = 6 : 7 ⇒ match C = 150 ⇒ multiply by 6

A : B : C : D = 96 : 120 : 150 : 175

Total parts = 541 ⇒ 1 part = 3787 ÷ 541 = 7

**∴ A = 96 × 7 = 672**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A : B = 4 : 5

B : C = 4 : 5

C : D = 6 : 7

Total amount = 3787

**Formula used:**

Combine ratios by equalizing common terms

**Calculation:**

⇒ A : B = 4 : 5 and B : C = 4 : 5

⇒ Make B equal ⇒ LCM of 5 and 4 = 20

⇒ A : B = 16 : 20 and B : C = 20 : 25

⇒ So A : B : C = 16 : 20 : 25

⇒ Now C : D = 6 : 7

⇒ Make C equal ⇒ LCM of 25 and 6 = 150

⇒ Multiply first ratio by 6 ⇒ 96 : 120 : 150

⇒ Multiply second ratio by 25 ⇒ 150 : 175

⇒ Final ratio = 96 : 120 : 150 : 175

⇒ Total parts = 96 + 120 + 150 + 175 = 541

⇒ Value of 1 part = 3787 ÷ 541 = 7

⇒ A = 96 × 7 = 672

**∴ The correct answer is 672.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Chain Ratio Method

Combine ratios by making common terms equal.

LCM Trick

Use LCM to match common variables.

Distribution Formula

Share = (ratio part ÷ total parts) × total amount.
